ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/cream) with a dark border; estimated 85% high-intensity to 15% low-intensity pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central zone across both lobes; dark low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge and tips; dense dark mottling and focal clusters concentrated at the peduncle insertion point and extending into the lower-medial areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 110 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels along the distal portions of the trailing edge; topography becomes smoother and more linear as it approaches the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edge, culminating in acute, tapered distal tips (fluke horns) oriented dorsally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins and tips of both lobes; scattered circular white depigmentation spots in the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical dark linear streaks visible on the medial portion of the right lobe (viewer's right) and left-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips and trailing edge margins; significant dark irregular scarring at the fluke base near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, dark, high-contrast pigment mark resembling a silhouette located centrally just above the peduncle insertion point.
